prompt.en: What kind of goods make up a large part of what Canada sells abroad?
prompt.fr: Quel genre de biens compose une grande part de ce que le Canada vend à l'étranger?

options.fr: Des produits de base tirés des ressources naturelles.

explanation.en: A large share of what Canada exports is made up of commodities that come from natural resources.
explanation.fr: Une grande part de ce que le Canada exporte se compose de produits de base issus des ressources naturelles.

source.quote: a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities.

verification.evidence: a large percentage of Canada’s exports are natural resources commodities.
